## Context / Problem
Merged work cites analysis artifacts under docs/experiments/ that were never actually committed. The packaged src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json (landed as bc0bdaf39a, Gerrit change 1891, ticket cranial-goodly-seahog / ba48-a88a-92bd-45d0) cites docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py in three _comment fields, and cranial-goodly-seahog's closing comments say 'Deliverables copied to docs/experiments/: calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, code-review-threshold-calibration.md, escaped_bug_analysis.py, escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md'. Ticket restoring-shallow-blobfish likewise records 'artifact: docs/experiments/write_parity_oracle_prototype.py' as the empirical basis for the surface-parity design that topaz-blubbery-mice implements. None of these five files exist on origin/main — every citation is dangling, so the provenance trail for the 7-member blocking set and the write-parity oracle design cannot be inspected from the repo. The files exist only as untracked working-tree state in one checkout; this ticket lands them.

## Approach
Commit the five already-written artifacts verbatim (they are the exact deliverables the closed tickets describe; no code changes, no behavior):
- docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py — the code-v3 sidecar calibration harness (analog of calibrate_plan_review_thresholds.py).
- docs/experiments/code-review-threshold-calibration.md — the calibration report (per-criterion signals table + precision-first proposal) that justified the four blocking flips.
- docs/experiments/escaped_bug_analysis.py — the escaped-bug correlation harness (43 regression bugs vs prior PASS reviews).
- docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md — its report (defect-match buckets, criteria-gap findings that seeded reflective-central-sponge, unaroused-undead-ibisbill, cherubic-content-woodpecker, restoring-shallow-blobfish).
- docs/experiments/write_parity_oracle_prototype.py — the behavioral conformance-oracle prototype whose results are recorded on restoring-shallow-blobfish and which topaz-blubbery-mice productionized.
docs/experiments/ is the established home for exactly this kind of investigation artifact (30+ existing peers, e.g. calibrate_plan_review_thresholds.py, derive_code_review_threshold.py). It is outside the make lint sources (src tests scripts) and outside the packaged wheel (packages = src/rebar), so the landing is docs-only and inert at runtime.

## Portability
Static documentation/analysis artifacts committed to the repo; nothing executes in CI or at runtime, no CI-provider trigger involved. Fully portable across environments with diverse or no CI.

## Scope
- docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py (new)
- docs/experiments/code-review-threshold-calibration.md (new)
- docs/experiments/escaped_bug_analysis.py (new)
- docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md (new)
- docs/experiments/write_parity_oracle_prototype.py (new)
No existing file is modified.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The five files above exist on main with content identical to the deliverables recorded on cranial-goodly-seahog and restoring-shallow-blobfish.
- [x] The criteria_routing.json _comment citations of docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py resolve to a real file on main.
- [x] No file outside docs/experiments/ is touched; make lint and make typecheck remain green (the directory is outside their source sets).
- [x] The change lands through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
